description: Create a monitor on its first check-in. The same slug uses the same monitor. A rejected creation writes no monitor or event. The slug becomes the monitor name and its identity: the same slug always means the same monitor, so a retry never creates a second one. Normalised to lowercase, `[a-z0-9-]`, 40 chars. Works by GET or POST.

slug.description: Name of the job; it becomes the monitor name.

name: ping_slug
title: Ping slug
